rationale: Backend-scoped change but non-trivial: replace static Pydantic Field(max_length=MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH) with runtime validators reading a configurable value across 4 request/response models (create, update, ai-generate input, ai-generate response); wire in DynamicConfig-backed setting with 30000 default; expose the effective limit to the UI via an endpoint; and cover behavioral nuances (reads of pre-existing oversized skills must not fail; oversized content updates must be blocked with a message stating the effective max). Multiple integration points + behavioral edge cases + test matrix (default/increased/exceeded/decreased) place this at M with brainstorming routing. Cross-repo Story overall; this run is the backend half.
